tasks.short: Maintain judges' law libraries and document versions

steps.what: Select appropriate library documents and capture authoritative identifiers and versions
Assemble linked documents and stage version updates for the law library
Verify library versions, resolve missing documents and publish internal holdings updates

tasks.design: Configure import and version staging in the existing library catalogue {OTHER}. The clerk selects material, verifies versions and updates internal holdings without automated legal interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated assembly and copying of document links and version information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue imports can stage updates from checked identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a document belongs in the library and which version is required for historical research.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk preserves context and avoids silently replacing historical sources.

reach.learn: Retain edition history and distinguish links from licensed content

evidence.claim: A configured catalogue staging workflow is an E1 proposal; no measured judicial library update deployment is provided.

assumptions: This task maintains holdings; identifying legal implications of changes belongs to the separate law-update task.

In s1 the clerk produces source identifier, edition or date, stable link, holdings action and access condition; 35 hours include capture and correction. Missing identifiers or unclear versions remain manual in s3.
OTHER means existing library catalogue; native imports and publisher link services precede custom integration.
No content is copied beyond permitted access and no automated deletion of historical versions occurs.
unknowns: Share of physical volumes and digital links
research_questions: Can staged imports reproduce a checked update batch while preserving historical editions and access conditions?

already_counted.description: Selection, source capture and final holdings verification

incremental.description: Maintain import mapping and audit version integrity
Maintain catalogue access and link integration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=65 yields 35 gross less 8 focal upkeep =27 central net. Report 0-6 until holdings updates are timed; physical work or existing publisher integration may remove the opportunity.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Call court calendars and administer oaths

steps.what: Perform courtroom duties by calling calendars and administering oaths to participants

tasks.design: Keep live courtroom coordination and oath administration with the authorized clerk. An existing calendar supports the proceeding without replacing participant checks or the spoken procedural act.
tasks.previous_blocker: Formal duties depend on the people present and the court's directions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calendars and procedural instructions support direct performance.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected absences, identification questions and changes during a hearing.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk responds to the courtroom and raises exceptions immediately.

reach.learn: Recognize procedural exceptions and communicate them clearly

evidence.claim: Human performance of live courtroom duties is an E1 proposal; no measured replacement capability is supplied.

assumptions: The baseline is performing live duties rather than preparing a separate calendar report.
The court calendar is produced by the separate scheduling process; the clerk verifies participant presence within s1 with all time retained. No machine relies on a free attendance or identity flag.
Existing procedural instructions suffice before any software build.
No new service or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Are calendar preparation activities separate from performing live courtroom duties?

already_counted.description: Participant checks, calendar calls and oath administration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gives zero gross and net saving. Scheduling gains are not attributed to live procedural duties.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reliable reference holdings and attentive courtroom support
reach: Learn version stewardship from legal librarians
Coordinate procedural exceptions with the judge
role.ambitious_version: A clerk who reduces repeated library assembly while retaining responsibility for live court duties and source integrity
